decision: Retain existing model3998 local Sit asset; do not promote model4997.
reason: Additional1000 iterations reduce joint tracking RMS in all8 matched CPU scenarios but worsen the known forward2cm COM case from13.7136deg to15.5351deg and peak torque from2.1484 to2.8985Nm. Both candidates pass7of8 course scenarios; this is not improved robustness.

protocol.course_verdict_caveat: HOLDS UP/WOBBLES are course pose-tracking labels, not physical certification or fall counts. The intended seated body tilt is nonzero.

visual_review.nominal: Sits, offers each paw, returns to a stationary standing pose.
visual_review.com_front: During right-paw shake, offered paw touches down after loss of rear-left support; posture recovers and finishes standing.

support_diagnostic.method: Pose-only nativeMuJoCo full-hull COM/contact reconstruction, not a force/inertial/friction or dynamic impossibility proof.
support_diagnostic.interpretation: Reference COM remains inside the assumed three-paw polygon. Forward COM reduces margin; actual rear-left contact is lost before peak error, leaving a diagonal pair and negative support margin. Offered front-right paw then touches down and changes the support triangle.
support_diagnostic.reference_contact_warning: Strict reference contacts can be absent because planted spheres sit0.7–3.2micrometres above ground from IK tolerance. Intended support polygon is explicitly projected and assumes contact availability.

follow_up: Separate smooth support-margin reference experiment authorized; preserve original reference and candidate, compare geometry/open-loop/initial checkpoint before any training.
